title: Why Holding Your Breath Stops Hiccups
caption:
Hiccups won't quit? Your vagus nerve has an off switch.
Xiao Bai puffs out his cheeks and holds his breath mid-hiccup, and a brain diagram lights up with a 'vagus nerve override' spasm reset.
Hiccups are a diaphragm spasm: holding your breath raises CO2 and chest pressure, overriding the vagus nerve so the spasm loop resets.
What's your go-to hiccup cure, and has the breath-hold trick ever worked for you?
Save this hack for the next time hiccups hijack your day.
